issues.description: Template declares number_of_qubits_query_register as a float (0.0) in ex5_grover_kakuro.py, while the problem and the solution expect an integer number of qubits. QuantumRegister/QuantumCircuit constructors require integer counts. This is a structural type error in the template that will raise runtime/type errors and block students from instantiating the registers as-is.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template placeholder to use an integer (e.g. 0) rather than a float. For example: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 0 (int). Preferably set the placeholder to a sensible integer (or documented int placeholder) so QuantumRegister calls in the template don't fail. Keep the intended exercise prompt (students fill in the proper integer, e.g. 4).
